clips.title: The story
paras: The Fate of a Loved One is a quest concerning Resaan, who ventured into the dangerous Ruins of Ban'aethal to scavenge supplies and never returned. Over a week later, his grieving partner asks travelers bound for the ruins to discover his fate and bring him home or recover his cherished heirloom.

The Fate of a Loved One centers on a desperate plea from someone whose partner, Resaan, ventured back into the Ruins of Ban'aethal. Despite earnest pleas for him to stay, Resaan felt compelled to brave the ruins in search of supplies, leaving behind someone who now waits in agonizing uncertainty.

More than a week has passed since Resaan set out, far exceeding any reasonable expectation for a swift return. Travelers bound for Ban'aethal are begged to search for him among the ruins—to guide him back if life remains, or to recover his family heirloom if only tragedy is left to find.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.
Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, adventurer, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... It feels as if our lives together had just started.
Thank you, adventurer. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
